4º de Primaria · Inglés · Tema 9

Present continuous

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________

Qué vas a aprender

  • Talk about actions happening now (lo que está pasando ahora)
  • Form the present continuous with am, is, are + -ing
  • Spell the -ing form correctly
  • Ask «What are you doing?» and describe a picture

Para pensar

Tu madre te llama por teléfono y te pregunta «What are you doing?». ¿Qué te está preguntando y cómo le contestarías?

Explicación

Actions happening now

We use the present continuous for actions that are happening now, at this moment: «Look! It's raining», «Shh! The baby is sleeping», «I'm reading a great book».

It's different from the present simple, which is for habits: «I read every night» (costumbre) / «I'm reading now» (ahora). En castellano: es igual que «estoy leyendo», «está lloviendo». La terminación -ing equivale a nuestro -ando o -iendo: reading = leyendo, playing = jugando.

How to make it: be + -ing

The present continuous has two parts: the verb to be (am, is, are) + the main verb with -ing. «I am playing», «She is eating», «They are running».

We use am with I; is with he, she, it; and are with you, we, they. In conversation we use short forms: I'm, she's, they're. En castellano: to be hace el papel de «estar»: «I'm eating» = «estoy comiendo».

Spelling the -ing form

Most verbs just add -ing: read → reading, play → playing, cook → cooking. Verbs ending in -e lose the e: write → writing, dance → dancing, make → making.

Short verbs with consonant + vowel + consonant double the last letter: run → running, swim → swimming, sit → sitting, get → getting. Truco: si la palabra es corta y termina en consonante-vocal-consonante, ¡dobla la última letra!

Negative: I'm not…

To make a negative, put not after am, is or are: «I'm not sleeping», «He isn't watching TV» (is not), «We aren't playing» (are not).

It's very useful to correct someone: «I'm not sleeping, I'm thinking!», «She isn't crying, she's laughing!». En castellano: «no estoy durmiendo» → «I'm not sleeping». Fíjate en que con I no existe la forma «amn't»: decimos siempre I'm not.

Questions: What are you doing?

For questions, put am, is, are first: «Are you listening?», «Is she sleeping?». Short answers: «Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.», «Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.»

The most famous question is What are you doing? (¿Qué estás haciendo?). Also: «Where are you going?», «Who is she talking to?». En castellano: aquí no necesitamos do: el verbo to be ya hace de ayudante.

Time words: now, at the moment, look!

The present continuous often comes with now, right now, at the moment (en este momento) and today: «We're having lunch at the moment», «She's working at home today».

Also, when we want someone to see something, we say Look! or Listen!: «Look! The cat is climbing the tree!», «Listen! Someone is singing». Compare with the present simple time words: every day, usually, on Mondays. Pista: si ves now, piensa en -ing.

Describing a picture

The present continuous is perfect to describe a picture or a photo. Look at the park: «A boy is flying a kite. Two girls are skipping (saltando a la comba). A man is walking his dog. A baby is sleeping in a pram. The sun is shining».

Start with In the picture or I can see: «In the picture, I can see a family. They are having a picnic». Consejo: usa is con una persona y are con dos o más.

Reading: a postcard from the beach

Read Paula's postcard: «Dear Grandma, I'm writing from the beach in Menorca! It's sunny and hot. Right now Mum is reading a book under the umbrella and Dad is swimming. My little brother is building a sandcastle. He isn't wearing his hat, oops! I'm eating a delicious ice cream. Some children are playing volleyball near us. We're having a great time! Love, Paula.»

Answer: What is Dad doing? Is her brother wearing his hat? What is Paula eating?

Let's practise: mime and guess

Play Mime and guess (mímica). One student picks a card with an action and mimes it in front of the class: brushing teeth, playing the piano, riding a horse, eating spaghetti… The class asks: «Are you swimming?» – «No, I'm not!» – «Are you dancing?» – «Yes, I am!».

Then the class says the full sentence: «She's dancing!». Consejo: fíjate en si preguntas a la persona («Are you…?») o hablas de ella al resto de la clase («She's… / He's…»).

Present continuous

Ejercicios

  1. Write the -ing form: play, make, sit.

  2. Complete with am, is or are: «They ___ singing.»

  3. Complete: «Look! The dog ___ (run).»

  4. Make it negative: «I'm sleeping.»

  5. Make it negative: «We are watching TV.»

  6. Make a question: «You are listening.»

  7. Short answer (no): «Is your brother studying?»

  8. Present simple or continuous? «I ___ (read) now.»

  9. Translate: «¿Qué estás haciendo?»

  10. Describe what three people in your house are doing now.

Practica

  1. We use the present continuous for…

    1. A) habits
    2. B) the past
    3. C) actions happening now

  2. «I ___ reading.»

    1. A) am
    2. B) is
    3. C) are

  3. «They ___ playing.»

    1. A) is
    2. B) are
    3. C) am

  4. The -ing form of «swim» is…

    1. A) swiming
    2. B) swimming
    3. C) swimmng

  5. The -ing form of «write» is…

    1. A) writeing
    2. B) writting
    3. C) writing

  6. «He ___ watching TV.» (negativa)

    1. A) isn't
    2. B) doesn't
    3. C) aren't

  7. «___ you listening?»

    1. A) Do
    2. B) Is
    3. C) Are

  8. «What are you doing?» means…

    1. A) ¿Qué haces cada día?
    2. B) ¿Qué estás haciendo?
    3. C) ¿Qué hiciste?

  9. Which sentence is present continuous?

    1. A) She's dancing.
    2. B) She dances.
    3. C) She danced.

  10. Which word goes with the present continuous?

    1. A) at the moment
    2. B) every day
    3. C) usually

Explícalo con tus palabras

Incluye: Para qué sirve el presente continuo; Cómo se forma con am, is, are y -ing; Las reglas de ortografía de -ing; Cómo se hacen negativas y preguntas, y en qué se diferencia del presente simple.

Resumen

Tarjetas de repaso

Recórtalas: pregunta delante, respuesta detrás.

present continuousLo que está pasando ahora.
I'm playingEstoy jugando.
She's eatingElla está comiendo.
-ing-ando / -iendo.
swimmingDoble consonante: swim → swimming.
He isn't…Negativa: no está…
What are you doing?¿Qué estás haciendo?
at the momentEn este momento.

Soluciones

  1. C) Ahora.
  2. A) I + am.
  3. B) They + are.
  4. B) Doble m.
  5. C) Se quita la e.
  6. A) is not.
  7. C) you + are.
  8. B) Ahora mismo.
  9. A) is + -ing.
  10. A) En este momento.

Soluciones de los ejercicios

  1. playing, making, sitting.
  2. are.
  3. is running.
  4. I'm not sleeping.
  5. We aren't watching TV.
  6. Are you listening?
  7. No, he isn't.
  8. I'm reading (now).
  9. What are you doing?
  10. Model answer: My mum is working. My dad is cooking. My sister is playing a video game.
